The response should not repeat any word more than 4 times. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a medieval king turning his empire's aesthetic into a proto-vaporwaveassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the rolling hills and lush forests of the kingdom, but something is off. The once-majestic stone walls now seem dull and grey, the flags bearing the royal crest now faded and worn. The king, KING ARIN, sits on his throne, surrounded by his advisors.

KING ARIN
(to his advisors)
I have a vision, my friends. A vision of a new era for our kingdom. An era of... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...futurism.

ADVISOR 1
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty?

KING ARIN
(nodding)
Yes. We will embrace the latest trends from the city. The art of the merchants, the music of the traveling performers... we will incorporate it all into our kingdom.

ADVISOR 2
(alarmed)
But, Your Majesty, what of our traditional ways? Our honor, our chivalry?

KING ARIN
(waving his hand)
Pfft, those are just relics of the past. We must move forward. (he gestures to a nearby servant) Bring me the latest fashion from the city.

The servant scurries off, returning with a collection of garish, neon-colored clothing.

KING ARIN
(excitedly)
Ah, yes! This is the future! (he puts on a bright pink jacket with yellow stripes)

CUT TO:

INT. CASTLE HALLWAY - DAY

The king's advisors look on in horror as the king prances down the hallway, his new outfit drawing strange looks from the other courtiers.

ADVISOR 1
(whispering)
What has the king done?

ADVISOR 2
(shaking his head)
I don't know, but I think we're in trouble.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The king, now dressed in a full-body neon jumpsuit, steps out onto the balcony, surveying his kingdom. The camera pans out, revealing a sea of identical, futuristic-looking buildings stretching out as far as the eye can see.

KING ARIN
(to himself)
Yes, this is it. This is the future. (he looks down at his outfit) And I am the king of this... (he searches for the right words)...this... (he shrugs)...this thing.

CUT TO:

INT. CASTLE THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors gather around the throne, looking on in dismay.

ADVISOR 1
(firmly)
Your Majesty, we must speak with you about your... (he gestures to the king's outfit)...fashion choices.

KING ARIN
(defensively)
What's wrong with my outfit? It's the latest from the city!

ADVISOR 2
(calmly)
Your Majesty, it's... (he searches for the right words)...it's not exactly... (he shrugs)...regal.

KING ARIN
(suddenly serious)
You know what? I don't care about your opinions. I am the king, and I will do what I want. (he gestures to the servant) Bring me the latest music from the city.

The servant scurries off, returning with a collection of cassette tapes.

KING ARIN
(excitedly)
Ah, yes! This is the sound of the future! (he puts on a pair of oversized, mirrored sunglasses)

CUT TO:

INT. CASTLE THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors look on in horror as the king starts to dance, his outfit glowing under the fluorescent lights.

ADVISOR 1
(whispering)
This is madness.

ADVISOR 2
(shaking his head)
I think we're in trouble.

FADE TO BLACK.
